items.text: Doubt loop ran: reviewer received ONLY artifact + contract (never the author's reasoning), with an issues-only prompt
Every finding classified: contract-misread, valid-actionable, valid-tradeoff, or noise; classifications recorded in decisions/
All valid-actionable criticals resolved, or explicitly overridden by the owner
Loop terminated in at most 3 cycles; if substantive findings remained, the result is EXHAUSTED_WITH_OPEN_FINDINGS and continuing required an owner override receipt
New trust boundaries got a threat pass (spoofing, tampering, repudiation, disclosure, denial, elevation)

redFlags: Reviewer output contains 'looks good' (issues-only prompts do not produce praise)
Two or more cycles with substantive findings but zero classified actionable — that is validation theater, not doubt
The author's rationale was passed to the reviewer

rationalizations.excuse: We already reviewed it ourselves carefully
rationalizations.reality: Self-review inherits the author's blind spots. The loop exists because agreement is cheap and refutation is information.
